purpose: Define the only model-footprint-reopened candidate: cpu_moe=41 plus a top768 exact MXFP4 x Q8_0 hot residual up/down residency path, with explicit correctness, TTFT, and RAM gates before performance promotion.

hard_bound.decision: Only the source-hidden top768 case has enough paper slack to justify a top1-first prototype. It still has a very small implementation budget.

vram_layout.rationale: Keep the accepted gate cache size unchanged and spend the one expert layer freed by cpu41 on a separate fixed hot-residual pool. Do not use a single unpartitioned LRU because that can evict accepted gate entries and invalidate the no-gate-penalty bound.

required_hot_updown_profile.selection: decode phase, sort by residual fallback_us descending, take top768 tensor/expert pairs
required_hot_updown_profile.pack_requirement: The current gate pack is insufficient. Build either a combined one-stream pack containing the existing gate entries plus top768 up/down entries, or add a second q80-hot O_DIRECT pack reader. The implementation must not fault the top768 payload through normal GGUF mmap during decode.

ttft_risk.decision: A synchronous top768 hot prefill before first token is likely TTFT-rejected. The prototype must either overlap hot prefill with existing gate prefill/prompt work or be recorded as TTFT-rejected and not promoted.

required_runtime_design.details: Generate a top768 up/down residual profile and a pack source for those entries. Preserve the accepted gate pack behavior and hashes or record any combined-pack hash separately.

Keep existing g_vcache dedicated to gate with GGML_MOE_STREAM_ONE_CACHE_MIB=13568 and GGML_MOE_STREAM_ONE_NAME_FILTER=ffn_gate_exps. Add a default-off q80 hot pool with 768 fixed slots keyed by tensor/expert. No LRU eviction between gate and q80 hot entries.

Use CPU fallback semantics: MXFP4 weights times Q8_0 activations. Down and up paths must pass or copy the already converted Q8_0 activation rows from params->wdata, or quantize F32 to Q8_0 on GPU with identical block scale semantics. Do not reuse the existing Q8_1 one-stream path.
Add a device vec_dot_mxfp4_q8_0 path: 32-element MXFP4 blocks, signed nibble lookup, int dot, scale by q8_0.d * mxfp4.e. Use one expert/row micro-kernel first; optimize only after correctness.

Cover both down and up fallback. Down currently calls ggml_cuda_moe_stream_one before CPU fallback. Up is inside the up/gate fallback path, so a hot q80 up hook must be added there as well; optimizing down alone cannot reach the top768 bound.

Source-hidden bound requires the q80 hot pool to be ready before most decode fallback uses. The implementation should support async prefill on a separate stream/thread and counters for attempted/inserted/ready-before-use/missed-before-ready. A synchronous TTFT-heavy mode is allowed only as a rejected diagnostic.

correctness_gates: Build must preserve accepted behavior when the new env is unset.
Before any strict cold performance run, run the fixed-text token-level top1 verifier against the accepted path. Required result: same_top1 for all checked positions and no first mismatch.
If a lower-level op compare is added, require max_abs and top1 agreement for representative up and down hot entries, but op compare alone is not enough to run a long benchmark.
France output must remain semantic, coherent, and complete.
performance_gates: TTFT <= 33617.688744 ms for promotion. TTFT-rejected diagnostics may be committed and marked rejected.
eval_tok_s must exceed 4.4 for SOTA promotion and ultimately target 10 tok/s.
Gate-cache counters must stay comparable to accepted SOTA; a gate hit-rate collapse invalidates the no-gate-penalty bound.
q80 hot counters must show high ready-hit coverage for the selected top768 entries; misses-before-ready must be included in gap analysis.

prototype_order.name: profile_pack_artifacts
prototype_order.action: Generate top768 profile and document pack-generation command/hash. No runtime code yet.

prototype_order.name: default_off_split_pool_skeleton
prototype_order.action: Add env-gated q80 hot pool allocation and prefill counters, but keep compute disabled. Verify accepted SOTA path unchanged when env unset.

prototype_order.name: q80_op_compare
prototype_order.action: Enable a tiny compare-only path for selected hot entries. Do not run performance. Reject on numerical/top1 mismatch.

prototype_order.name: fixed_text_top1
prototype_order.action: Run the existing fixed-text top1 verifier. Reject on first mismatch.

prototype_order.name: strict_cold_diagnostic
prototype_order.action: Only after top1 passes, run France strict cold with cpu_moe=41, gate cache 13568, q80 hot top768. Record TTFT even if rejected.

reject_without_runtime_code_if: A top768 pack cannot be generated without increasing host page-cache pressure during decode.
The split-pool VRAM layout cannot allocate with at least roughly 100 MiB free after workspaces.
The design cannot source-hide the new cpu41 layer and top768 hot entries without TTFT exceeding the acceptance gate.
A concrete Q8_0 top1 verifier command cannot be defined.

decision.first_runtime_checkpoint: split-pool skeleton plus q80 op/top1 verifier, not a performance benchmark
